about.title: About SignPost
about.body:
SignPost is a free, community-maintained map that helps people in the Greater Seattle Area find resources like food banks, shelters, drinking water, bathrooms, phone charging, and harm reduction services.

Anyone can add or update a location. Community notes let people share tips, flag changes, and verify that information is still accurate.

Tap a pin on the map to see details and get directions.

SignPost does not collect personal data. No account is required.
about.helpAddData: Know a resource that isn't on the map? Tap the + Add button to submit it. Keeping the map current is the most direct way to help.
about.helpPoster: Print a poster and put it up in your community — laundromats, shelters, libraries, community centers. Anyone who sees it can scan the QR code or type the URL to access the map without needing to know the app exists.
about.helpFeedbackDesc: Have thoughts on the app? Something not working, confusing, or missing? Your feedback goes directly to the developers.
